metric_definitions.attack_time: 10-90% rise time (ms) of the smoothed Hilbert envelope at the hit onset (material hardness).
metric_definitions.decay_rate: Amplitude decay rate 1/tau (1/s) from the slope of the hit's noise-compensated energy decay curve over its first 10 dB (damping).
metric_definitions.fundamental_frequency: Pitch (Hz) of the played note (SwiftF0) in cases marked "f0": "pitch"; otherwise the lowest resonance (>= 150 Hz) excited by the hit.
metric_definitions.spectral_centroid: Magnitude-weighted mean frequency (Hz) of the hit (-20 to +180 ms around the onset) after subtracting twice the clip's background power spectrum (brightness).
metric_definitions.spectral_flux: Mean log-mel spectral flux across the hit onset, -94 to +180 ms (transient sharpness and contrast).
metric_definitions.spectral_rolloff: Frequency (Hz) below which 85% of the spectral magnitude of the same background-subtracted hit spectrum lies.
metric_definitions.temporal_modulation: Amplitude-modulation index (0-1) of the whole clip's envelope (loudness fluctuation).
metric_definitions.rt60: Reverberation time (s): 60 dB over the slope of the hit's noise-compensated energy decay curve between -5 and -15 dB (T10).
metric_definitions.drr: Clarity C50 (dB, ISO 3382-1): energy in the first 50 ms after the hit peak over the energy after it (room dryness).
metric_definitions.hit_values: Per-hit metrics are measured at the detected onset matched to each annotated hit (the annotated time when unmatched); a pair test compares clip values (mean over the matched hits, median for rt60 and drr), a single-video test the per-hit sequence over all hits.
metric_definitions.seed_weight: 0.5 x hit coverage above chance + 0.5 x CLAP score of the seed (each the worse side of a pair).
metric_definitions.confidence: Per test: summed weights of the seeds that show the expected behaviour / number of seeds; missing or failed seeds count in the denominator.
metric_definitions.increase/decrease: A seed votes for a direction when counterfactual - factual exceeds tau = max(2% of the pooled mean, 0.25 x the robust SD of the pooled seed values).
metric_definitions.no_change (pair): Passes when, over >= 3 seeds with both values, |median of ln(counterfactual / factual)| (the difference for drr and temporal_modulation) is within the metric's margin (half the median labelled change on the original recordings); every such seed then counts.
metric_definitions.no_change (single video): A seed votes when the coefficient of variation of its per-hit values (SD in dB for drr) is below the metric's threshold; undefined (null) for temporal_modulation, which has no per-hit sequence.
metric_definitions.ascending/descending: A seed votes for a trend when the Spearman correlation of its per-hit F0 with hit order (the sign of the change for 2 hits) passes a length-dependent threshold.
metric_definitions.opposite_confidence: Summed weights of the seeds that vote for the opposite direction or trend / number of seeds; null for no_change tests.
metric_definitions.net_confidence: confidence - opposite_confidence: 0 at chance, negative when seeds mostly move the wrong way; null for no_change tests.
metric_definitions.overall: Overall confidence = mean over test cases of the mean confidence of their tests (net: of their directional tests); a metric's confidence = mean over its tests; a test case without generated audio scores 0; null entries are left out of every mean.
metric_definitions.hit_coverage: Fraction of annotated hits matched by a detected onset (tolerance 0.10-0.25 s, set by the number and spacing of the hits), mean over seeds (missing or failed seeds 0).
metric_definitions.hit_coverage_above_chance: Per seed, hit coverage minus the same fraction at times with no annotated hit (at least the tolerance + 0.1 s from every hit), floored at 0, so onsets everywhere earn little; mean over seeds (missing or failed seeds 0).
metric_definitions.timing_error: Mean |detected - annotated| onset time (s) of the matched hits, mean over seeds.
metric_definitions.perfect_alignment: Fraction of seeds with every annotated hit matched.
metric_definitions.clap: CLAP audio-caption cosine similarity of the audio up to the case duration, mapped to [0, 1], mean over seeds (missing or failed seeds 0).
metric_definitions.factual/counterfactual/min/overall: hit_coverage, hit_coverage_above_chance, perfect_alignment and clap per side: factual and counterfactual = mean over test cases; min = mean over test cases of the worse side of a pair, or the only side of a single-video case; overall = mean over every video of every test case (a pair counts both videos).
